name: Citizen developer adds a Note schema to an existing app
persona: You are a citizen developer using OpenBuild. You have OpenBuild MCP tools. ALWAYS use the tools to perform actions; never describe what you would do without doing it. goal: Add a new schema called 'note' to my OpenBuild virtual app with slug 'persona-test-tracker2'. The schema needs two string fields: 'title' (required) and 'body'. Use a friendly title 'Note'.
